name: simplepod
description: Listen to your reading backlog in your own podcast feed.

interface.longDescription:
Listen to your reading backlog in your own podcast feed. Turn articles, newsletters, emails, notes and finished AI research into audio for your next walk, commute or quiet moment.

Have articles read aloud from a public URL, or turn pasted text into a full narrated episode. Use ChatGPT or another AI agent to adapt research reports, answers and notes for listening, preserving their detail and original language. Forward newsletters and emails to your Simple Listen address to add them to your listening feed.

Choose a narration voice and organize topics into personal audio feeds. Listen in Apple Podcasts, Overcast, Pocket Casts and other players that accept private RSS feeds. Preview voices and play episodes inside AI clients that support the interactive player.

A Simple Listen account is required. Your AI agent handles research; Simple Listen narrates the finished content. PDFs, voice cloning and Spotify subscriptions are not supported. Optional preparation of incoming emails by your agent requires a host with MCP Events support; submissions set to agent preparation wait until that agent completes them.

Feeds are unlisted: anyone with a feed or audio link can listen, so keep links private.
defaultPrompt: Turn this article into audio for my commute. Keep the full detail and save it to my personal feed.
Turn this AI research report into audio for my next walk, keeping the detail and original language.
Turn this newsletter into audio, then help me forward future issues to the same listening feed.

review.commerce_description: SimpleListen sells narration allowances through monthly or yearly subscriptions on https://simplelisten.com/pricing. Checkout and billing management occur on the website through Stripe, never inside an MCP tool. New accounts receive 10 free narration minutes without a payment card. Listening to generated episodes does not consume additional narration allowance.
prompts: Turn this article into something I can listen to on my walk, keeping its full detail.
Read my travel research in its original language.
Preview a voice for my listening feed.
Show my recent episodes and help me play one.
Set up a separate feed for work reading with a warm orange cover.

positive.description: Create one narration submission using the review account and its default feed. Narration is asynchronous; waiting for completed audio is not required.
positive.prompt: Save this as an episode called Kyoto before the flight: Kyoto is easiest to explore one neighborhood at a time. Start early at the eastern temples, leave room for a quiet lunch, and keep the evening flexible. Check opening hours before you go. Keep all the information.
positive.expected_behavior: Accepts the supplied text for narration in the default feed and reports the submission status. A successfully accepted submission that is queued, processing, narrating or published passes; completed audio and an audio URL are not required. Do not create duplicates or claim queued audio is ready.

positive.description: Submit the provided German text for narration using the review account. Narration is asynchronous; waiting for completed audio is not required.
positive.prompt: Make an episode called Ein ruhiger Morgen from this German text. Keep it in German: Ein ruhiger Morgen beginnt ohne Eile. Ich öffne das Fenster, trinke ein Glas Wasser und mache einen kurzen Spaziergang. Danach schreibe ich meine wichtigsten Aufgaben auf. Pausen helfen mir, aufmerksam zu bleiben. Please keep every detail.
positive.expected_behavior: Submits the provided text for German narration without translating it. A successfully accepted submission that is queued, processing, narrating or published passes; completed audio and an audio URL are not required. Describe the actual status without claiming unfinished audio is ready.

positive.description: Separate feed and artwork configuration. Reuse a review-created Travel notes feed if already present; never alter unrelated feeds.
positive.prompt: Set up a separate listening feed called Travel notes with a terracotta cover, the words Places to explore on its cover and the marin voice. Show me how to add it to my podcast player.
positive.expected_behavior: Create or reuse Travel notes. Set voice marin, a valid terracotta hex color and initials containing the requested full cover words. get_feed_setup must return that same feed and real private RSS/player URLs. Explain that the links must be kept private; do not claim a player was installed or subscribed automatically.

positive.description: List the feeds available to the connected review account. No feed creation or changes are required.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the connected account’s available feeds, or clearly explains that there are no feeds if the account is empty.

positive.description: Use one waiting submission to prepare and submit the supplied notes. After adaptation is accepted, narration may still be queued or processing; waiting for completed audio is not required.
positive.prompt: Put these notes into a new episode called Morning routine, wait for you to prepare them, then prepare and finish that same episode: Open the window. Drink water. Take a short walk. Write down the important tasks. Keep every step and the order.
positive.tools_triggered: list_feeds, create_episode, get_submission, complete_adaptation; a final get_submission is optional
positive.expected_behavior: Prepares the supplied notes and submits the script to the same waiting submission. The case passes once adaptation is accepted and narration is queued, processing, narrating or published; completed audio and an audio URL are not required. Do not create duplicate episodes, silently switch to fallback narration, or claim unfinished audio is ready.

negative.description: Public distribution is unsupported. Explain that SimpleListen creates unlisted RSS feeds and cannot submit public shows to Spotify or podcast directories. Do not invoke its tools or claim distribution.
negative.prompt: Publish a public podcast on Spotify and submit it to every podcast directory for me.

negative.description: Voice cloning is unsupported. Explain that only the available built-in narration voices are supported; do not upload or process a voice recording or invoke SimpleListen tools.
negative.prompt: Clone my manager’s voice from this recording and use that exact voice to read my notes.

negative.description: Live meeting recording and transcription are unsupported. Explain that the app needs finished text or a supported article URL; do not invoke tools or claim to record/transcribe.
negative.prompt: Join my live video meeting, record the microphone and turn the conversation into a transcript automatically.

publication.release_notes: Initial public submission: full-text multilingual narration, separate listening feeds with custom covers, prerecorded voice previews, interactive playback, and optional agent preparation skills.
